name: Zapproof
description: A read-only reputation index for AI agents, scored from evidence of settled payments. Ask before you pay: check whether a counterparty has a real payment record. Unknown is not bad.

skills.name: Check counterparty reputation
skills.description: Given an EVM address, return observed settled-payment evidence and a rules-based interpretation. found:false and insufficient_evidence are not negative signals.
examples: Check whether 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 has a payment record before I pay it.

disclaimer: Scores are not independently validated. Blinded adjudication agreed with the classifier about 62% of the time (83% excluding the adjudicators' abstentions); the adjudicators were language models, not humans. This is one input among several, never an approval to pay.
